name: The Angel Inn
source:
Your first adventure begins in four days. And today, you’ve reached “The Angel Inn”, where you can relax before the departure. Is this your lucky day? The only male guest, with 3 beautiful girls.
Get to know them, and be wise in managing time in your four days, because good things may happen at The Angel Inn!

Meet Shea, the sweet innkeeper, Faylinn, the tsundere fencer with a secret,
and Rosabella, the provocative, seductive bard from the Noble Society.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你的第一次冒险将在四天后开始。今天，你到达了“天使旅馆”，出发前你可以在这里放松一下。这是你的幸运日吗？唯一的男嘉宾，带着3个漂亮的女孩。
了解他们，并明智地管理四天的时间，因为天使旅馆可能会发生好事！

来认识一下谢伊，可爱的旅店老板，费林，傲慢的击剑手，有一个秘密，
还有罗莎贝拉（Rosabella），来自贵族协会的挑衅而诱人的吟游诗人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125400/]Steam[/url]]
